'''Runai Sculdun''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was [[Marriage|married]] to [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="Rix Road" /> In [[5 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|112}}</ref> she visited [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Chandrilan Embassy|residence]] on [[Coruscant]] alongside Davo and his son [[Stekan Sculdun]],<ref name="Rix Road" /> as Davo wished for Stekan to be introduced to [[Leida Mothma]].<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

Runai was present on [[Chandrila]] at the [[Marriage|wedding]] of Stekan and Leida in [[4 BBY]]. She was central to the Chandrilan wedding ceremony and the traditional elements of the event. After the ceremony and during the ensuing dancing, the delighted Runai offered Mon Mothma drinks and encouraged her to join the celebrations.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>

In [[3 BBY]], Davo and Runai hosted a soirée on Coruscant. Runai would accompany [[Perrin Fertha]], Mon Mothma's husband, in rounding up the handful of people chosen to receive a tour of Sculdun's [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|personal gallery]]. During the tour, Runai was shocked when [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] revealed that the [[Carmeenian]] people skinned others alive.<ref name="Festive">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]], a full year after Mon's public denunciation of Emperor [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], Runai rode in an limospeeder with Perrin.<ref name="JKE">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Runai-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art for Runai by [[Michael Wilkinson]] and [[Andrei Riabovitchev]]]]
Runai Sculdun appeared in "[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]," the twelfth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], where she was portrayed by [[Rosalind Halstead]]. She was identified by name only in the episode's credits.<ref name="Rix Road" />
